target: credibility gates as run on 2026-10-27 (gpufe/gate1c_friction.py, gate1d_stick_memory.py, gate2_fsu.py; results/gpufe_verify/*): what the production solver has actually passed
claim: The production path for the slip-out answer is the GPU Newton solver with sliding Coulomb contact on curved surfaces under force (moment) control. No case of that kind has passed a gate. (1) Friction slip has passed only with the old dynamic-relaxation solver: gate 1c calls slv.Solver, not NewtonSolver. (2) Gate 1d, the only friction gate run with Newton, never approaches slip: max |Fx/Fz| 0.073 at mu 0.5 (15 % of the limit), stick fraction 1.0 throughout. It shows that a purely elastic stick returns to zero, which is close to tautological after the F-0003 fix. (3) The only gate 2 pass (flexion) exercised no sliding contact at all: facet contact force 0.0 at every one of the 20 increments. Flexion separates the facets, and the 5 directions where the facets touch fail with NaN. The tied disc-endplate interfaces also report 0.0 force throughout, which is either a reporting gap (tied force not logged) or ties not engaging; unverified which. (4) Gate 2 compares only the main-axis rotation. Coupled rotations, C3 translation (1.67 mm at t 2) and the facet force vs FEBio are not compared, though METHODS_COMPARISON gate 2 promises 'facet force vs FEBio'. The max curve deviation is 4.65 % against a 5 % pass limit. (5) solver.py:105 silently gives a contact facet zero penalty when its owner element is not found ('eps.append(0.0)'). No warning is raised, and that facet then lets the cage pass through the bone. A voxel cage with many small surface pieces is the case most likely to trigger it (unverified). (6) No gate report carries provenance (git hash, dirty flag, FEBio binary version / hash, input hashes), contrary to GOVERNANCE.md 'Keeping the data clean'. The FEBio binary lives in the old repository (config.json febio_bin).
evidence: gpufe/gate1c_friction.py:62 's = slv.Solver(...)'; gate1d_stick_memory.py:46 NewtonSolver, :18 MU 0.5, AMP 0.004; results/gpufe_verify/gate1d/gate1d_report.json n 10: max_Fx_over_Fz 0.0727, min_stick_frac 1.0, cycle_end 7.9e-10; results/gpufe_verify/gate2/flex_pos_y.json: facet_force_gpu_N {C34_L_FC 0.0, C34_R_FC 0.0}, history[*].contacts all 0.0 incl. tie_disc_C3 / tie_disc_C4, max_curve_dev_of_end 0.0465, Forced x at t 2.0 = 1.667 mm; gate2_fsu.py:44-47 (pass = main-axis rotation only); docs/METHODS_COMPARISON.md:53 ('facet force vs FEBio'); gpufe/solver.py:105; gate reports: grep for 'git|sha|hash' in results/gpufe_verify/gate1d/gate1d_report.json returns 0 matches; config.json:3.
how_to_reproduce: Read the cited files; grep -c hash results/gpufe_verify/*/*.json.

fix_options.option: Verifier-owned gate set for the production path, all with NewtonSolver: (a) gate 1c rerun; (b) force-controlled block at 0.9 mu and at 1.1 mu, hold, reverse, 3 cycles (stick -> slip -> stick transitions); (c) tilted plane and spherical cap; (d) rigid disc under torque (spin at T = 2/3 mu N R, Goyal et al. 1991, Wear 143:307); (e) gate 2 in a direction with facet contact
Make gate 2 compare coupled rotations, translations and facet force with FEBio, and log tied-interface forces; fail loudly on zero-penalty facets
Add a provenance block (git hash + dirty flag, febio binary sha256, input sha256, options) to every gate report; refuse to record PASS from a dirty tree

summary_zh: 決定「cage 會不會滑出」最後要靠 GPU 牛頓法求解器加上真實摩擦接觸，在彎曲的骨面上、以施加力矩的方式計算。但到目前為止，這種組合沒有通過任何一道關卡。（一）摩擦滑動測試（1c）用的是舊的求解器，不是牛頓法。（二）新的黏著記憶測試（1d）雖然用牛頓法，但摩擦力最多只用到上限的 15%，從頭到尾都沒有滑動。（三）唯一通過的完整節段測試（前屈）中，小面關節的接觸力每一步都是零，也就是根本沒有測到接觸；有接觸的其他五個方向全部數值爆掉。椎間盤與終板之間的黏合力也全部顯示為零，原因不明。（四）第二關只比較主要轉角，沒有比較耦合轉動、位移和小面關節力；誤差 4.65%，非常接近 5% 的門檻。（五）如果程式找不到接觸面所屬的元素，會默默把該處的接觸剛度設為零，cage 在那裡可能直接穿過骨頭，而且不會有任何警告。（六）所有驗證報告都沒有記錄程式版本、FEBio 版本和輸入檔雜湊值。
